item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `ImageWrapper` with `images: list[dspy.Image]` and uses it as the signature's `image` input field."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds a demo wrapper with three images and a query wrapper with one image, wraps the demo in `dspy.Example`, and formats via `dspy.XMLAdapter().format(...)`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Prints and inspects `messages[1]['content']` and `messages[-1]['content']`, operating on structured content lists rather than a flattened string."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the demo user message contains exactly three `image_url` blocks via `count_image_blocks(messages[1]['content']) == 3`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the final live-query user message contains exactly one `image_url` block via `count_image_blocks(messages[-1]['content']) == 1`."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `CUSTOM-TYPE-START-IDENTIFIER` does not appear in the formatted messages, checking sentinel text does not leak through."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
